name: 天气
author: Yggdrasil
description: 查任意城市的实时天气与未来几天预报（Open-Meteo，不需要密钥）。

fields.label: 温度单位
fields.hint: celsius 或 fahrenheit。这是你的偏好，不是每次调用都能改的东西 —— Agent 应当照着返回里的单位渲染。

endpoints.name: find_city
endpoints.label: 查城市坐标
endpoints.description: Look up a city by name and get its coordinates, country, region, timezone and population. **Call this first**: forecast needs latitude/longitude, and you must never invent coordinates. Returns results[]; if several cities share the name, pick by population or by the region the user meant, and tell them which one you used.

params.name: name
params.description: city name (local script works best, e.g. 北京 or Tokyo)

params.name: language
params.description: language for the returned place names

endpoints.emptyHint: No city matched. Try the name in its own script (北京 rather than Beijing, or the reverse), try a nearby larger city, or drop the district part of the name. Two attempts is the budget — after that, tell the user you could not find the place.

endpoints.name: forecast
endpoints.label: 取天气
endpoints.description: Current conditions plus a daily forecast for a coordinate. Pass the latitude/longitude and timezone that find_city returned. Returns current (temperature_2m, apparent_temperature, relative_humidity_2m, wind_speed_10m, weather_code), current_units, daily (weather_code, temperature_2m_max, temperature_2m_min) and daily_units. **Read the units from the response** instead of assuming °C. weather_code is a WMO code — the guide has the table for turning it into words.
